description: Copia org-wide Renovate base policy. Extend with local>copia-automation/.github

hostRules.description: Auth for private @copia-automation packages on GitHub Packages via the RENOVATE_TOKEN Mend secret; without it lockfile updates fail with 401

lockFileMaintenance.description: Enabled weekly by config:best-practices; moved into the Sunday window

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Dependabot security updates own vulnerability PRs: they fix transitive dependencies in lockfiles, which Renovate cannot. Keep Dependabot alerts and security updates on in every repo that extends this preset

packageRules.description: Rollbacks and replacements should be deliberate human calls, not bot PRs
Overrides and resolutions are deliberate human pins on transitive deps; Renovate must not touch them
Batch patch updates per package manager
All GitHub Actions updates. Only uses: references, so runner OS, container/service images and setup-action version inputs stay out
One PR per Node version across Dockerfiles, .nvmrc and setup-node inputs. Includes patch so the per-manager patch rule does not split them. Exclusions mirror group:nodeJs
One PR per Python version across Dockerfiles, .python-version and setup-python inputs. Includes patch, as for node
One PR per Go version across golang images, go.mod go/toolchain directives and setup-go inputs. Includes patch, as for node
The uv image and setup-uv version inputs bump together. Includes patch, as for node
eslint, its plugins/configs and parsers move together; the built-in groups split them across eslint, typescript-eslint and stylistic
Adds the eslint companions that packages:eslint does not list
vite plugins and vitest move with vite. Separate rules because one rule ANDs its matchers
Adds vitest and @vitest/* to the vite group
electron needs its packaging toolchain bumped too; node-abi must know a new electron ABI before native modules rebuild
webpack core, CLI/dev-server, loaders and plugins are coupled
pytest plugins track pytest
golang.org/x modules require each other (x/net needs x/sys) and are all v0, so every bump is a minor
terraform-aws-modules majors require matching hashicorp/aws provider majors
Serilog sinks and extensions track Serilog majors
xunit, its VS runner, the test SDK and coverlet move together; the built-in xunit-dotnet group misses the runner and SDK
WixToolset packages must share one version, so patches join too
dd-trace-go v2, its contrib/* modules, the v1 shim (v1.74+ wraps v2) and orchestrion must share one release, so patches join too. A core-only bump breaks the build

Storybook packages must share one version. Own group so a Storybook regression cannot block the npm batch. Last so it beats the eslint group for eslint-plugin-storybook. The chromatic CLI versions independently
